components.description: Dense, line-based program record that stacks cleanly on mobile.
components.css: .ds-schedule{display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px 130px 1fr 100px 80px;gap:1rem;align-items:center;padding:1.2rem 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(6,17,27,.2);background:#dce5e2;color:#06111b}.ds-schedule small,.ds-schedule time,.ds-schedule span,.ds-schedule em{font:500 .7rem/1.2 Geist Mono,monospace}.ds-schedule strong{font:560 1.1rem/1.2 Geist,sans-serif}.ds-schedule em{color:#7c5516;font-style:normal}@media(max-width:520px){.ds-schedule{grid-template-columns:32px 1fr auto}.ds-schedule time{grid-column:2}.ds-schedule strong{grid-column:2/-1}.ds-schedule span{grid-column:2}.ds-schedule em{grid-column:3;grid-row:1}}

narrative.overview: The system treats an academic workshop page as a live security map: precise, high-contrast, and sober enough for research, with just enough signal color to make attack paths and provisional status impossible to miss. Photography is environmental evidence, not decoration; the cyan path and node language connects inputs, tools, coordination, and defense.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight and chalk surfaces with oxidized cyan as the active signal.
Editorial-scale headlines paired with terse mono operational labels.
Fine rules, open grids, and very limited rounding.
Explicit amber markers for tentative or cautionary states.
Responsive structures that collapse from four columns to two and then one.

rules.name: The Signal Economy Rule
rules.body: Cyan identifies system structure or the next action; amber is reserved for tentative status, caution, and focus. Neither is decorative fill.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Human arguments use the sans display register; system metadata uses mono. Do not introduce a third expressive typeface.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Information sits in the same field and earns hierarchy through scale, tone, and rules—not ornamental shadows.

dos: Do mark every unconfirmed event detail as tentative in both language and visual state.
Do use fine rules and aligned metadata to structure dense academic information.
Do preserve 16px minimum body text, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep cyan and amber rare enough to retain semantic force.
donts: Don't imply official AAAI-27 acceptance or add a submission destination before one exists.
Don't turn every content group into a rounded floating card.
Don't add gradients, decorative glows, or ambient shadows to simulate polish.
Don't use attack-path lines where no actual dependency or threat relationship exists.
